verdict.rationale: Working Copy documents a 'Repository Agent' AI assistant you interact with via conversation to browse files, search content, read/modify files, commit, pull and push — directly matching conversational repo insight/actions. However, evidence doesn't specifically confirm insights into 'open pull requests' via this agent, nor independent/hands-on corroboration of the feature working as described. Missing for 10: evidence of PR-specific conversational queries, third-party/hands-on validation of Repository Agent behavior, and detail on scope/limits of its natural-language understanding.
